description.value: Days Inn by Wyndham Terrace is a branded chain hotel on Lakelse Avenue in Terrace, BC, a regional hub in the Skeena River corridor of northwestern British Columbia. It is one of the more recognizable lodging options in a community that serves as a gateway to the Coast Mountains and Nisga'a territory. Cyclists touring Highway 16 or the Nisga'a Highway would find Terrace a natural overnight stop.
